hypothesis: On fresh unfamiliar causal laws, a trainable eight-slot public factual memory that learns to mix common and context-specific evidence from previous physically observed chosen-action consequences will improve changed-law action selection without losing unchanged-law transfer or old-context cold recall, relative to freshly trained same-budget single-bank, two-bank, context-blind and conventional controls. Any claimed advantage must be caused by informative factual feedback, not visible phase labels or synthetic change timing.

design.physical_sequence: 16 actually chosen factual action-consequence supports: publicly visible context A then context B at positions 6,8,10; no future or unchosen outcomes supplied to learners
design.public_features: R85/R86 physical cues, R88 observed factor probes and role tags, chosen action and actual scalar reward, public phase and switch marker; same information and order for comparable arms
design.evaluator_private: Old/new law masks, change/unchanged truth, both counterfactual query action outcomes, optimal actions, heldout score and hidden right answer are evaluator-only after training
design.adaptive_router: Shared eight-slot and separately addressable eight-slot factual memory are BOTH derived from previously observed support rewards. A trainable scalar mix gate for each query receives only public current-query context plus shared/private memory, counts and evidence mismatch. It must not read old/new operator IDs, private changed flag, hidden truth table or future rewards. The gate is fitted on the same factual FIT labels and optimizer budget as all controls; all router parameters count toward CPU cost.
design.outcomes: Old-before-B, old-after-B, new-after-B optimal action accuracy; changed-vs-unchanged law slices; old-memory interference; actual query oracle regret; whole-process time; parameter counts; cold restart exact parity
primary_controls: same-init random or constant-gate ablation with unchanged network capacity
same-init feedback shuffled within action and public context
fresh fully trained role-aware GRU with matched inputs
fresh fully trained role-aware MLP with matched inputs
fixed nonlearned full 256-rule public-evidence Bayesian posterior
design.diagnosis: Report gate distribution separately by changed vs unchanged regimes only in evaluator analysis, never as an input or training target. Include no-phase/mislabeled public switch negative and a noncausal switch-only control, both without access to private law changes.
restrictions: No prior original or development heldout data replay
No hidden truth or paired counterfactual training labels
No new controller, runner, scheduled task, paid API or FORGE coupling
Never promote a negative development result

evaluation.cross_os_reproducibility: Require exact count parity across Linux and Windows for every accuracy subgroup, all gate conditions and each frozen pass/fail; note wall clock variability separately
